description: This file defines various classes and grains related to streaming testing in an Orleans-based environment, including stream item data classes, observer implementations, producer and consumer grains, and reentrant variants. It includes test-specific logic for stream subscription, production, and consumption tracking.

classes.name: StreamItem
classes.description: Serializable class representing a stream data item with string data and stream GUID.

classes.name: ConsumerObserver
classes.description: Implements IAsyncObserver for StreamItem, tracks items consumed, manages stream subscription, and provides consumer control methods.

classes.name: ProducerObserver
classes.description: Implements IProducerObserver, manages production of stream items, timers for periodic production, and tracks items produced.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing producer logic, manages multiple ProducerObserver instances, supports producing series and periodic series.

classes.name: PersistentStreaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: Persistent version of the producer grain, saves and restores producer state.

classes.name: Streaming_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing consumer logic, manages multiple ConsumerObserver instances, supports subscribing and retrieving consumption metrics.

classes.name: PersistentStreaming_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: Persistent version of the consumer grain, restores consumer state.

classes.name: Streaming_Reentrant_ProducerConsumerGrain
classes.description: Reentrant grain combining producer and consumer for streaming tests.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerConsumerGrain
classes.description: Grain combining producer and consumer functionality, managing respective observers.

classes.name: Streaming_ImplicitlySubscribedConsumerGrainBase
classes.description: Base class for implicitly subscribed consumer grains observing stream subscription events.

classes.name: Streaming_ImplicitlySubscribedConsumerGrain
classes.description: Implicit stream subscription grain for a specific namespace.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation logic, initializes logger and observer lists.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Initializes producer to a specific stream, registering with stream provider.

methods.name: ProduceSequentialSeries
methods.description: Produces a series of stream items sequentially.

methods.name: ProduceParallelSeries
methods.description: Produces a series of stream items in parallel.

methods.name: GetItemsProduced
methods.description: Returns total number of items produced.

methods.name: AddNewConsumerGrain
methods.description: Adds a new consumer grain and links it to the current stream.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes a consumer observer to a stream.

methods.name: GetItemsConsumed
methods.description: Returns total number of items consumed.

methods.name: StopBeingProducer
methods.description: Stops the producer, disposing timers and finalizing production.

methods.name: VerifyFinished
methods.description: Asserts that production has finished and cleans up.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Stops consumer observers and cleans up subscriptions.

methods.name: DeactivateConsumerOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates consumer on idle after delay.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles stream subscription event, initiating consumer subscription.
